title: myroxylon pubescens
intro: Myroxylon pubescens, commonly known as Palo Santo, is a plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family, native to the tropical regions of the Americas. Palo Santo is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, skin conditions, and stress. The therapeutic actions of Palo Santo include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and boost mood due to its aromatic properties and bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Palo Santo include limonene, beta-pinene, and myrcene, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
